description: Hand-authored synthetic campground, account and reservation records for reproducible checks; not a benchmark task. No real facility, person or payment data.

sources.description: Hand-authored synthetic records. Workflow rules modelled on Recreation.gov public help pages (15-minute cart hold, $10 change fee); the release schedule, refund ladders, cutoffs and alert effects are Switchback's own.

transformations: Fixed UTC-07:00 facility times; amounts in cents; IDs stable across resets.

review.notes: Automated checks do not replace human review of realism, variation and reuse permissions.
